title: vigil
description: Built a Rust log analytics engine backed by an async Tokio daemon that ingests JSON event streams and serves sub-millisecond filtering and aggregation to concurrent clients, with a checksummed write-ahead log for fast crash recovery.

title: pgraph
description: Created a probabilistic graph inference engine in Go that models directed graphs with independent Bernoulli edge probabilities, enabling exact and sampled reachability analysis and probabilistic path queries for risk and reliability use cases.

title: Portfolio Management Risk Estimator
description: Built a full-stack application that simulates portfolio performance and assesses risk exposure. Tracks and updates market data for the top 50 companies in the S&P 500.
